name: @noeos/verification-engine-workspace
description: Governed workspace for the Noeos verification engine and CLI.
author: Noeos contributors

scripts.api:check: npm run build && api-extractor run --config packages/engine/api-extractor.json
scripts.ci: npm run toolchain:check -- --profile node-24-primary && npm run policy:check && npm run docs:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run api:check && npm run license:check && npm run security:audit && npm run security:signatures && npm run pack:check && npm run consumer:check && npm run reproducibility:check && npm run sbom
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node .build/tests/tests/index.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-branches=98 --test-coverage-functions=98 --test-coverage-lines=98 --test-coverage-include='packages/*/dist/**/*.js' .build/tests/tests/index.test.js
